title: Maia Eden EP launch- downstairs
description:
Free event in the vaults- Join for Maia Eden’s EP release. She started singing at a very young age and her unique voice was first evident when she joined the choir in her local church, where she mastered the art of harmonising. Her personal lyrics about life and love bring Jackson Browne to mind, while her unique voice is reminiscent of Natalie Merchant and K.D. Lang.

Tickets are free but please reserve in advance at: https://www.hilltoplive.co.uk/event-details/maia-eden-ep-launch/form

title: Mountain Song
description:
Mountain Song is a hard-driving bluegrass duo bringing the sound of the genre’s golden era back to the stage.

Will Greenway and James Hickman deliver tight harmony, singing and masterful guitar work, rooted firmly in early Appalachian tradition. Historically accurate and sharply played, this is bluegrass with grit, wit, and real bite.
